source_status: Source contract only; no imported photometric series or ready model comparison
citation: Shu et al. (2024), Unveiling Illumination Variations During a Lunar Eclipse: Multi-Wavelength Spaceborne Observations of the January 21, 2019 Event, Remote Sensing 16(22),4181
band_contract: Effective lunar wavelengths, not monochromatic measurements. Full response curves are not supplied. Nominal B2 450-520, B3 520-600, B4 630-690, B5 760-900 nm from https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/13/18/3752 Table 1 are not sufficient to define the instrument response.
geometry: Table 2, p3: 17 UTC epochs, Sun-Moon and observer-Moon ranges, subsolar/subobserver selenographic coordinates and phase. GF-4 viewpoint differs from geocenter: phase -5.47 to +4.81 degrees. Surface albedo and directional reflection weighting matter.
totality: U2 04:41:20 UTC; U3 05:43:16 UTC. No valid totality samples: last preceding observation 04:30, next observation 06:00.
figure4: p9: measured full-disk spectral irradiance; integrated calibrated pixel radiance, distance-normalized to Sun-Moon 1 AU and observer-Moon 384400 km. Phase/opposition response remains.
figure7: p12: B2 measured irradiance divided by the Xu et al. 2023 Hapke model prediction at corresponding phase. Not an observed eclipse/full-Moon ratio or pure atmospheric E/F. Linear raster scale poorly resolves low irradiance ratios. No numerical table or error bars.
figure6: p11: four-band radiance of three lunar sites (3x3 pixels, about 1.5 km). No uneclipsed site baseline shown; albedo and BRDF remain.
figure8: p13: B4/B2 radiance-ratio maps at 03:30, 03:40, 03:50, 04:10 UTC. Text p12-13 reports ribbon width about 120-190 km and red/blue ratios about 0.8-1.0. These include lunar composition; not a target HSV color or atmospheric-only ratio. Authors report bluing imperceptible to naked eye.
calibration: Sections 3.1-3.2: dark subtraction, bad pixels, destriping/flat field, piecewise nonlinear DN-to-radiance calibration. Figure 3 true color uses a 2% linear display stretch, which is not radiometric data.
availability: p14: original data on request from corresponding author; not publicly available due to privacy. No raw frames imported here.
readiness: Candidate for future band-convolved spatial/width validation. Needs actual observation geometry and lunar spectral albedo/BRDF handling before comparison with atmospheric illumination. No fitted parameters or claimed validation result.
